stops.note: literally "descent", the earthly incarnation of a deity
stops.meaning: the descent of a deity to earth

stops.note: a descent of a Hindu god, especially Vishnu, to Earth; first recorded in 1784 in the writing of Sir William Jones, founder of the Asiatic Society of Bengal; computer 'avatars' date from the 1980s

current_meaning: a digital representation of a person, or an embodiment of a concept or deity
